item.title: Contratto di ricerca: “New generation exploration of π-conjugated systems through classical and automated synthesis: from molecules to materials” (CNR - Istituto di struttura della materia)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-25 18:00
Institution: CNR - Istituto di struttura della materia, Tito Scalo (Pz)
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-05 Chimica organica

The research activities will be focused on the synthesis of π-conjugated organic systems through both conventional and automated synthetic approaches. The work will involve the design, synthesis, and characterization of donor and acceptor π-conjugated organic semiconductors, including narrow-bandgap non-fullerene acceptors (NFAs), for next-generation organic photovoltaic (OPV) devices. Two-dimensional materials, such as Covalent Triazine Frameworks (CTFs), will also be investigated for catalytic and photocatalytic applications. The successful candidate will contribute to the development and validation of experimental procedures aimed at comparing traditional and automated synthetic…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Produzione accumulo e gestione di energia tramite tecn. avanzate e abilitanti per la transizione energet Smart sector integration Preparazione e caratterizzazione chimico-fisica di materiali avanzati e interfacce funzionali per applicazioni energet (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-02 Chimica fisica

The project aims to develop advanced materials and micro- and nanostructured interfaces for energy conversion, storage, and management technologies. Thin films with different compositions, including oxides, metals, and hybrid materials such as MOFs, will be designed and synthesized. Their structural, chemical, and electrochemical properties will be correlated with functional performance through advanced physicochemical surface and electrochemical characterization.
